thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Repeated inter-region health flaps detected. Routing engine observed a fallback loop across regions (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu) starting 1764004287. Spike in routing retries and elevated 502/504s. Paging on-call: @oncall-amber — paged via phone+slack.

oncall-amber: got the page, joining. can someone dump the routing policy + probe logs?

sre-joel: grabbing logs now. initial observation: health probes oscillating for model-variant "variant-v2-quant" on us-west. probe shows alternating PASS/FAIL every ~12s. looks like the variant is flapping under load, triggers fallback to next region, which then sees increased load and fails in turn.

eng-runtime-lucy: that matches recent deploy — we pushed a lighter quantized build for v2 yesterday with a different readiness probe timeout (100ms -> 30ms). could be too strict.

raj: copying relevant config:

```
routing.fallback.max_hops=5
routing.probe.consecutive_failures=3
variant.pin_policy=auto
```

maria: customer telemetry: 3 high-usage tenants showing sustained latency 3x and error rate double in last 20m. one tenant (acme-inc) hit client-visible 429s due to queued requests. CS alerted. @customer-success-ellie, want me to draft outage note?

customer-success-ellie: yes pls. mention degraded inference and retries, no data loss, apologetic tone. will coordinate with accounts.

oncall-amber: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable cross-region auto-fallback to break the loop 2) increase probe.failure threshold to 6 for 10m 3) pin traffic for impacted tenants to stable variant (variant-v2) in us-east if healthy 4) rollback the 30ms readiness change if needed.

eng-runtime-lucy: rolling a quick patch: bumping routing.fallback.max_hops=1 and routing.probe.consecutive_failures=6 via runtime flag now. applying to control-plane and will propagate.

sre-joel: also disabling auto-fallback for the service (flip feature flag) to prevent cascade. command: `/infra feature-toggle routing_auto_fallback --service inference-api --off`

oncall-amber: executing pin for acme-inc and two other tenants to variant-v1-stable in us-east: `/routing pin --tenant acme-inc --variant variant-v1-stable --region us-east --ttl 30m`

incident-bot: action taken: feature-toggle routing_auto_fallback OFF (request id abc123). runtime flags updated (max_hops=1, probe.failure_threshold=6).

raj: logs after change show probes in us-west still flapping but no cross-region handoff events. fallback attempts dropped to near zero. latency for pinned tenants improving within 60s.

maria: customer metrics show error rate dropping for acme-inc and two others. CS told customers about mitigation.

oncall-amber: next steps: 1) keep auto-fallback off for 30m while we stabilize 2) run a canary of the readiness timeout rollback to 100ms on a single host in us-west 3) coordinate a safer rollout of quantized variant with more permissive probe timeouts and CPU limits 4) postmortem once fully resolved.

eng-runtime-lucy: canary started on host i-0a1b2c3d, readiness 100ms restored. monitoring for 5m.

sre-joel: starting timeline notes for postmortem: root cause hypothesis - probe sensitivity + underprovisioned variant-v2-quant led to transient fails, auto-fallback policy with max_hops>1 amplified the failure into a hop-chain loop. mitigations: reduced max_hops, increased failure threshold, pinned critical tenants, canary rollback.

customer-success-ellie: messaging queued, sending to affected customers now. no escalations yet but one enterprise requesting phone brief.

oncall-amber: paging update: no further escalations. reducing noise, leaving incident channel open. will hand off to next on-call at 1764008400.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT STATUS: Mitigated (service degraded -> stabilizing). follow-up: ENG_RUNTIME to evaluate probe defaults and variant sizing; SRE to add alert to detect multi-hop fallback spikes.

maria: adding short blameless notes to timeline. anyone see any config drift besides the readiness change?

eng-runtime-lucy: nothing else unusual. we'll schedule a config freeze/check and add a guardrail to prevent readiness timeout < 50ms for prod variants.

sre-joel: will prepare a runbook step to temporarily disable auto-fallback when multi-hop count > 2 for >60s.

oncall-amber: handing off to @raj for post-incident follow-up. thanks team. :raised_hands:

raj: taking follow-up. collecting logs/traces and will open postmortem ticket with action items.

incident-bot: thread closed for now; reopen if regressions observed.
